# Behavioral and values

Your real stories, motivation and judgement: ownership, conflict, mistakes, and why this company.

## <a id="track-both"></a>Both tracks

- <a id="beh-motivation-and-disagreement"></a>**Why do you want to work at Anthropic, and where do you disagree with its approach?**
  - Self-presentation · Senior · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#beh-motivation-and-disagreement) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=beh-motivation-and-disagreement&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20beh-motivation-and-disagreement)
  - Tests: Whether motivation is informed and leaves room for independent judgement.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Connect specific public work or mission choices to your own professional interests.
    - Offer a reasoned disagreement and state what evidence could change your view.
    - Explain how you would contribute while engaging constructively with that disagreement.
  - Read: [Careers](https://www.anthropic.com/careers) (Anthropic)
- <a id="beh-mistake-learning"></a>**Describe a mistake you made, its consequences and what you changed afterward.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#beh-mistake-learning) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=beh-mistake-learning&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20beh-mistake-learning)
  - Tests: Whether you take responsibility and show learning through concrete behaviour.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - Describe your decision and what you knew at the time.
    - Explain impact, recovery and your responsibility without blaming others.
    - Identify a lasting change and evidence that it helped.
  - Read: [Postmortem Culture: Learning from Failure](https://sre.google/sre-book/postmortem-culture/) (Google)
- <a id="beh-unresolved-disagreement"></a>**Tell me about a time you disagreed with someone and could not persuade them.**
  - Behavioral · Senior · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) † · ✍ [Answer](../answers/leadership.md#beh-unresolved-disagreement) · [Suggest a fix](https://github.com/eiler2005/ai-interview-atlas/issues/new?template=correction.yml&question=beh-unresolved-disagreement&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20beh-unresolved-disagreement)
  - Tests: Whether you work constructively after losing an argument.
  - A strong answer covers:
    - State both positions fairly and explain your evidence.
    - Describe the decision process and how you supported the agreed action.
    - Explain the result, limits of commitment and what you learned.
  - Read: [Leadership Principles](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/our-workplace/leadership-principles) (Amazon Jobs)
